chunk_text:
What is a Savings Account?
A savings account lets you keep your money safe in a bank while earning a small interest, usually around 2–4% per year.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a Current Account?
A current account is mainly for businesses. It allows unlimited daily transactions but doesn't pay interest on the balance.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a Fixed Deposit?
A fixed deposit lets you lock in a sum of money for a set period to earn a higher interest rate than a regular savings account.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What does KYC stand for?
KYC stands for Know Your Customer. It's how banks verify who you are using documents like Aadhaar or PAN card.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a cheque?
A cheque is a written instruction to your bank to pay a specific amount to someone else from your account.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What happens when a cheque bounces?
When a cheque bounces, the bank refuses to pay it — usually because there's not enough money in the account. It can lead to a penalty or even legal action.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a Demand Draft?
A demand draft is a prepaid payment made through the bank, so it can't bounce. It's great for paying college fees or government offices.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an overdraft?
An overdraft lets you withdraw more money than you have in your account, up to a limit set by the bank. You pay interest on what you use.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a joint account?
A joint account is shared between two or more people. All account holders can access and manage the funds together.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a nominee in a bank account?
A nominee is someone you choose to receive your account funds if you pass away. They don't legally own the money, but they receive it on behalf of your family.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a Recurring Deposit?
A recurring deposit lets you save a fixed amount every month for a chosen period. At the end, you get back all your money plus interest.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a zero balance account?
A zero balance account doesn't require you to keep any minimum amount. You can open it with no money and use it freely.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
Can a minor open a bank account?
Yes, a minor below 18 can open a bank account, but it's operated by a parent or guardian until they turn 18.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a senior citizen savings account?
It's a special savings account for people above 60 years. It offers higher interest rates and sometimes priority service at branches.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an NRI account?
An NRI account is for Indians living abroad. There are three types — NRE, NRO, and FCNR — depending on the currency and whether funds need to be repatriated.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an account number?
Your account number is a unique code your bank gives your account. It's used to identify you during any transaction.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a bank passbook?
A passbook is a small booklet your bank gives you. It records all your deposits, withdrawals, and the current balance in your account.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a cheque book?
A cheque book is a set of blank cheques given by your bank. You fill and sign them to make payments to others.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How much interest does a savings account earn?
Most Indian banks offer 2–4% per year on savings accounts. Some small finance banks offer up to 7%.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a dormant account?
If you don't make any transaction in your account for 2 years, it becomes dormant and gets locked for security reasons.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a BSBD account?
BSBD stands for Basic Savings Bank Deposit account. It's a zero-balance account made for low-income individuals with basic banking features.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I reactivate a dormant account?
Visit your bank branch with your KYC documents and submit a written request. Once verified, your account will be reactivated.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a sweep-in account?
A sweep-in account automatically moves extra money above a threshold into a fixed deposit to earn higher interest, and brings it back when needed.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a bank locker?
A bank locker is a small safe inside the bank where you can store valuables like gold, jewellery, or important documents for a yearly fee.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What documents are needed to open a bank account?
You need an identity proof like Aadhaar or PAN card, address proof, passport-size photos, and a filled application form.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is TDS on Fixed Deposit?
If your FD interest is more than ₹40,000 a year, the bank deducts 10% TDS. For senior citizens, the limit is ₹50,000.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is Form 15G?
Form 15G is a self-declaration form for people below 60. Submitting it tells the bank not to deduct TDS if your total income is below the taxable limit.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is Form 15H?
Form 15H is for senior citizens. It asks the bank not to deduct TDS if their total tax payable is nil.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a salary account?
A salary account is a zero-balance savings account where your employer credits your salary each month. It often comes with extra perks like free insurance.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a tax-saving FD?
A tax-saving FD has a 5-year lock-in and qualifies for deduction under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act, up to ₹1.5 lakh per year.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
Can I withdraw an FD before maturity?
Yes, but you'll usually pay a penalty of around 0.5–1% less interest than the original rate.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is interest payout in FD?
FD interest can be paid monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or at maturity. Cumulative payout at maturity earns the most because of compounding.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is DICGC insurance?
DICGC insures your deposits up to ₹5 lakh per bank. So if the bank fails, you're guaranteed to get back up to ₹5 lakh.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a PPF account?
PPF is Public Provident Fund. It's a 15-year government savings scheme with tax-free interest of around 7.1% per year.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a Sukanya Samriddhi account?
It's a government savings scheme for girl children below 10 years. It offers around 8.2% interest and full tax exemption.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the Atal Pension Yojana?
Atal Pension Yojana is a pension scheme for unorganized sector workers. You contribute until 60 and get a fixed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is PMJDY?
Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana is a scheme to give every Indian a bank account. It offers a zero-balance account with a RuPay debit card and accident insurance.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a RuPay card?
RuPay is India's own card payment network, like Visa or Mastercard but made by NPCI. It works at ATMs, POS machines, and for online payments.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the minimum balance in a savings account?
It varies by bank. Government banks like SBI may require ₹0 to ₹3,000 while private banks may ask for ₹5,000 to ₹25,000 depending on the city.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What happens if I don't maintain minimum balance?
The bank charges a non-maintenance fee, typically ₹100 to ₹500, if your account falls below the required minimum balance.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an escrow account?
An escrow account is a neutral account where money is held safely until both parties in a deal (like property purchase) meet their obligations.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a co-operative bank?
A co-operative bank is owned and run by its members. It mainly provides banking services to rural communities and small businesses.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a payments bank?
A payments bank can accept deposits up to ₹2 lakh and offer digital payments but cannot give loans. Examples include Airtel Payments Bank and India Post Payments Bank.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a small finance bank?
A small finance bank serves people who don't have easy access to regular banking, like small farmers and micro businesses. Example: AU Small Finance Bank.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the NRE account used for?
NRE account is used by NRIs to park their foreign earnings in India in Indian rupees. The interest is tax-free in India and the money can be sent back abroad freely.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an NRO account?
NRO is for managing income earned in India by an NRI, like rent or dividends. Interest is taxable and repatriation has limits.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a FCNR account?
FCNR lets NRIs deposit money in foreign currency (USD, GBP, EUR, etc.) without any exchange rate risk. Interest is tax-free and the deposit is fully repatriable.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is account nomination and why is it important?
Nomination lets the bank release funds to your chosen person after your death, avoiding delays or legal complications for your family.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an inoperative account?
An account with no transactions for 2 years is called inoperative. You need to submit fresh KYC at the branch to make it active again.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How can I close a bank account?
Visit your branch, submit a closure request form, return your debit card and unused cheques, and get any remaining balance transferred or in cash.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a bank guarantee?
A bank guarantee is a promise by the bank to pay a specific amount to someone if the bank's customer fails to meet their contractual commitment.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a letter of credit?
A letter of credit is issued by a bank guaranteeing a seller will get paid as long as they meet the delivery conditions. It's widely used in international trade.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a trust account?
A trust account holds money managed by one person (trustee) for the benefit of another (beneficiary) under a legal agreement.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an account statement?
An account statement is an official record of all your transactions — deposits, withdrawals, charges, and interest — for a specific period.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
Can I open a bank account online?
Yes. Most banks let you open an account online by filling a form, uploading KYC documents, and completing a video KYC call.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is video KYC?
Video KYC lets you complete identity verification through a live video call with a bank official from your home, without visiting the branch.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a current account for businesses?
A current account gives businesses unlimited daily transactions, overdraft facilities, and cheque books. It doesn't pay interest but provides all the tools a business needs.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an average monthly balance?
Average monthly balance is the average of your daily closing balances in a month. Banks require you to maintain this to avoid penalty charges.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a banker's cheque?
A banker's cheque is issued by the bank itself on your behalf using bank funds. It's safer than a personal cheque because it won't bounce.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a multipurpose financial inclusion card?
It's a single card issued by banks under financial inclusion programs that combines savings, insurance, and credit access for rural customers.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an NBFC?
NBFC stands for Non-Banking Financial Company. It offers loans and investments like a bank but doesn't have a banking licence. Examples: Bajaj Finance, HDFC Ltd.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
Can I have multiple bank accounts?
Yes, you can have accounts in as many banks as you want. But each account has its own maintenance requirements and charges.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a bulk deposit?
A bulk deposit is a single deposit of ₹2 crore or more. Banks often offer special negotiated interest rates for these.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is auto-renewal of FD?
If you don't give any instruction when your FD matures, the bank automatically renews it for the same duration at the current interest rate.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a partial withdrawal from FD?
Some banks allow you to break only a part of your FD while the rest continues earning interest at the original rate.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the PMMY loan?
Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana provides small business loans up to ₹10 lakh through banks and MFIs without collateral for non-farm businesses.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a regional rural bank?
Regional rural banks (RRBs) are government-owned banks that serve rural areas, giving loans to farmers, artisans, and laborers. They are co-owned by the central and state government and a sponsor bank.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a self-help group bank linkage?
Banks provide loans directly to self-help groups (SHGs) of rural women, who then lend to members. This helps people without collateral access credit.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is account re-activation?
To reactivate a dormant or inoperative account, visit the branch with KYC documents, fill a reactivation form, and do a transaction to restore normal access.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the difference between savings and current account?
A savings account earns interest and limits daily transactions. A current account offers unlimited transactions without interest, and is meant for businesses.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a MICR code?
MICR stands for Magnetic Ink Character Recognition. It's a code at the bottom of your cheque used by machines to process and clear it quickly.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an IFSC code?
IFSC is Indian Financial System Code. It's an 11-character code that identifies your specific bank branch for electronic fund transfers like NEFT, RTGS, and IMPS.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I find my IFSC code?
You can find your IFSC code on the first page of your cheque book, your passbook, the bank's website, or on a cheque leaf.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a mini statement?
A mini statement shows your last 5–10 transactions. You can get it at an ATM, through SMS banking, or by giving a missed call to your bank.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a cheque truncation system?
CTS replaces physical cheque movement with digital images during clearing, making the process faster and reducing errors.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the Positive Pay System?
Positive Pay requires you to share the cheque details with the bank before presenting it. This helps the bank catch fake or altered cheques.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a currency chest?
A currency chest is a storage facility at certain bank branches that holds RBI's stock of notes and coins for distribution to nearby branches.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a nidhi company?
A nidhi company is a type of NBFC that takes deposits from and lends only to its own members, encouraging savings within a small community.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the difference between NRE and FCNR?
NRE accounts hold foreign earnings in Indian rupees. FCNR accounts hold foreign earnings in the original foreign currency, protecting against exchange rate changes.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an account aggregator?
An account aggregator is an RBI-licensed service that lets you securely share your financial data across banks and apps with your consent.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a SHG?
SHG stands for Self-Help Group. It's a small group of people, usually women, who save together and take turns getting small loans from a pooled fund.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the NACH system?
NACH is National Automated Clearing House. It automates bulk payments like salaries, EMIs, SIPs, and utility bills between banks.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a flexi deposit account?
A flexi deposit combines a savings account with an FD. Extra money above a limit goes into an FD automatically to earn more interest.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an account opening bonus?
Some banks offer cashback, welcome gifts, or reward points when you open a new account or upgrade to a premium account.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the difference between nominee and legal heir?
A nominee receives the account balance after your death for safekeeping, but the legal heirs under your will or succession law are the actual owners.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a succession certificate?
A succession certificate is issued by a court to allow legal heirs to claim funds from a deceased person's bank account when there's no will.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a passbook update?
Passbook update means visiting your bank branch or using a passbook printing kiosk to record all your latest transactions in your passbook.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is TDS deduction from savings account interest?
Banks deduct TDS if total interest on savings account exceeds ₹10,000 per year for regular customers. You can avoid it by submitting Form 15G or 15H.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a joint account mode of operation?
For a joint account you can choose: Either or Survivor (any one can operate), Former or Survivor (primary holder operates), or Jointly (both signatures required).
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I update my mobile number in a bank account?
Visit your branch with your old and new mobile number and a valid ID proof, fill a request form, and your number will be updated usually within one working day.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I change my address in a bank account?
Submit a request at your branch along with a fresh address proof like an Aadhaar, utility bill, or rent agreement. Some banks allow this online too.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a SCSS account?
SCSS is Senior Citizen Savings Scheme. It's a government-backed investment for people above 60, offering higher interest rates with a 5-year tenure.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a bank's role in the economy?
Banks collect savings from people and lend them to businesses and individuals. This keeps money flowing through the economy and supports growth.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code's impact on banks?
The IBC lets banks take faster legal action against large defaulters by initiating resolution or liquidation of the borrower's assets through the NCLT.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a stale cheque?
A cheque becomes stale if it is not presented to the bank within 3 months from the date written on it. The bank will not honour a stale cheque.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an ante-dated cheque?
An ante-dated cheque has a date earlier than the date it was written. It's valid as long as it's presented within 3 months of the written date.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a post-dated cheque?
A post-dated cheque carries a future date. The bank will not process it until that date arrives.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a bearer cheque?
A bearer cheque can be encashed by anyone who presents it at the bank counter — no name is required. This makes it risky if lost.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an order cheque?
An order cheque pays only to the person whose name is written on it. The bank verifies identity before making payment.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a crossed cheque?
A crossed cheque has two parallel lines on it meaning it can only be deposited into a bank account and not encashed directly at the counter.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is account closure procedure?
Submit a written request, return your debit card and unused cheques, and make sure all pending transactions are cleared. The bank will close the account and pay out the balance.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a savings bank interest calculation?
Banks calculate interest on your daily closing balance and credit it to your account quarterly, usually in March, June, September, and December.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the maximum FD tenure?
Fixed deposits can be opened for a minimum of 7 days and a maximum of 10 years, depending on the bank's product offerings.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a gold savings scheme at a bank?
Some banks offer gold savings schemes where you can make regular payments and redeem them as gold at the end of the scheme period.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an individual account?
An individual account is a standard bank account held in the name of a single person who is the sole owner and operator.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
Can a housewife open a bank account?
Yes, any Indian citizen regardless of employment status can open a savings account with valid KYC documents.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the PMJJBY scheme?
Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana is a government life insurance scheme linked to bank accounts. It offers ₹2 lakh life cover for a yearly premium of ₹436.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is PMSBY?
Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana offers ₹2 lakh accidental death cover for a yearly premium of just ₹20, linked to your savings account.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an account holder?
An account holder is the person or entity in whose name a bank account is officially registered and who has the authority to operate it.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a corporate banking account?
A corporate banking account is designed for large businesses and offers services like cash management, trade finance, payroll, and foreign currency accounts.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a flexi recurring deposit?
A flexi RD allows you to vary your monthly deposit amount, unlike a regular RD where the amount is fixed. It gives more flexibility to irregular earners.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a multi-currency account?
A multi-currency account holds balances in multiple foreign currencies. It's mainly used by frequent international travellers and businesses dealing in multiple countries.
metadata: {"category": "Basic Accounts", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a debit card?
A debit card is linked to your bank account. When you use it to shop or withdraw cash, the money is taken directly from your account.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a credit card?
A credit card lets you borrow money from the bank to make purchases. You pay it back later, and if you miss the deadline, you're charged interest.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a PIN?
PIN stands for Personal Identification Number. It's your 4–6 digit secret code used to authorise card transactions at ATMs and shops.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an ATM?
An ATM is Automated Teller Machine. It lets you withdraw cash, check your balance, and do basic banking without visiting a branch.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is mobile banking?
Mobile banking is using your bank's app on your smartphone to transfer money, pay bills, check your balance, and manage your account.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is net banking?
Net banking lets you log in to your bank's website to do all your banking — transfers, bill payments, fixed deposits — from any browser.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is OTP?
OTP is One-Time Password. It's a temporary code sent to your phone or email to confirm that it's really you doing a transaction.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is NEFT?
NEFT is National Electronic Funds Transfer. It lets you send money to any bank account in India. Transfers happen in batches every 30 minutes, 24x7.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is RTGS?
RTGS is Real-Time Gross Settlement. It's for transferring large amounts (above ₹2 lakh) instantly. It works 24x7 and is settled in real time.

metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:

chunk_text:

What is a credit card billing cycle?

What is a credit card grace period?

What is a credit card minimum payment?

What is credit card interest?

What is a credit card cash advance?

What is a debit card international usage?

What is a credit card reward program?

What is a credit card annual fee?

What is a card block request?

What is a digital loan?

What is SIM swap fraud?

chunk_text:
What is a recurring payment?
A recurring payment is an automatic debit that happens every month for things like loan EMIs, insurance premiums, or streaming subscriptions.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is NACH debit?
NACH debit is an automatic payment pulled from your account by a lender or service provider after you authorize it once via a mandate.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a NACH return charge?
If a NACH debit fails because your account had insufficient funds, the bank charges you a return fee — usually ₹100 to ₹500.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is Net Banking 2FA?
Net banking uses two-factor authentication: your password (first factor) and an OTP sent to your registered mobile (second factor), to keep your account safe.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a payment app PIN?
A payment app PIN is a 4–6 digit code you set in UPI apps like Google Pay or PhonePe to authorize each money transfer from your phone.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a banking app update?
Banks regularly update their apps to fix security issues, add new features, and comply with RBI guidelines. Always keep your banking app updated.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is biometric login in banking?
Biometric login lets you access your banking app using your fingerprint or face instead of a password, making it faster and more secure.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the e-Rupee?
The e-Rupee is India's Central Bank Digital Currency launched by RBI. It's a digital form of cash, equal in value to physical rupee notes.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is CBDC?
CBDC is Central Bank Digital Currency. In India, RBI's Digital Rupee is a CBDC that works like cash but in digital form, without needing a bank account.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an IBAN?
IBAN is International Bank Account Number. It's a standard format for bank account numbers used in international transfers, especially in Europe and the Middle East.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a SWIFT code?
SWIFT code is a unique code identifying your bank's international address. It's needed when sending or receiving money across countries.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is cross-border payment?
Cross-border payment is sending money from one country to another. It involves currency conversion and is processed through SWIFT or correspondent banks.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a wire transfer?
A wire transfer is an electronic transfer of funds between banks, often used for international payments. It's secure but may take 1–5 business days.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a remittance?
Remittance is money sent by someone working abroad back to their family in their home country. In India, remittances from NRIs are a major source of income.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the RBI Retail Direct platform?
RBI Retail Direct is a platform where you can directly buy government bonds, treasury bills, and sovereign gold bonds online without a broker.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is Sovereign Gold Bond?
Sovereign Gold Bonds are RBI-issued bonds that give you returns linked to gold prices plus 2.5% annual interest. No storage risk and capital gains are tax-free on maturity.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a Demat account?
A Demat account holds your shares and securities in electronic form, like a bank account holds money. It's needed for trading in the stock market.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an online fixed deposit?
You can open an FD through net banking or your mobile app without visiting a branch. The rate is the same as at the branch.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is 3D Secure for credit cards?
3D Secure is an extra authentication step — usually an OTP — required for online credit card transactions to prevent unauthorised use.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is card-not-present fraud?
Card-not-present fraud happens when someone uses your card details (number, CVV, expiry) for online purchases without having your physical card.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a mobile POS terminal?
A mobile POS is a card-swiping device connected to a smartphone. Small merchants use it to accept debit/credit card payments on the go.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a QR code merchant?
A merchant who displays a QR code on their counter for customers to scan and pay using any UPI app, without needing a card machine.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is cardless cash withdrawal?
You can withdraw cash at certain ATMs using just your mobile banking app and a one-time code — no card needed.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a UPI transaction ID?
Every UPI payment generates a unique transaction ID (UTR number). Use it to track your payment or raise a dispute if something goes wrong.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a NEFT UTR number?
A UTR (Unique Transaction Reference) number is generated for every NEFT and RTGS transfer. It's used to track or dispute a transaction.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a digital savings account?
A digital savings account is opened and operated entirely online. It works like a regular savings account but with no physical branch visits required.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is real-time balance update?
After any transaction, your account balance is updated instantly in your mobile app or net banking, so you always know exactly how much you have.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an SMS transaction alert?
Banks send you an SMS every time a transaction happens on your account — credit, debit, ATM withdrawal — so you can immediately detect fraud.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a bank's 24x7 helpline?
Most banks have a toll-free 24-hour helpline where you can block cards, report fraud, get balance info, or raise complaints anytime.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a payment failure and auto-refund?
If an online payment fails but money is deducted, the bank must auto-refund within 5 business days. If not done, they owe you compensation.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is BBPS bill payment?
Through BBPS, you can pay any recurring bill — electricity, broadband, water, insurance, school fees — through any bank app or payment platform.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a bank token?
A bank token (hardware or software) generates a one-time code for added security when logging into net banking or authorizing large transactions.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a push notification in banking?
Push notifications are alerts from your bank app for every transaction, low balance, new offers, or due payments — keeping you instantly informed.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a one-time password for banking?
An OTP is a temporary 4–6 digit code sent to your phone to confirm a transaction or login attempt. It expires in 60–300 seconds and can't be reused.
metadata: {"category": "Digital Banking", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a loan?
A loan is money you borrow from a bank and agree to pay back over time with interest.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a home loan?
A home loan is money borrowed from a bank to buy or build a house. You repay it in monthly instalments over 10–30 years.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a personal loan?
A personal loan is an unsecured loan you can use for any purpose — medical bills, travel, wedding, or home repair. No collateral is needed.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a car loan?
A car loan is taken to buy a vehicle. The car itself acts as security. You repay it in EMIs, usually over 3–7 years.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a gold loan?
A gold loan is where you pledge your gold jewellery or coins at the bank and get cash in return. It's quick and doesn't need a credit score.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an education loan?
An education loan helps students fund their higher education in India or abroad. Repayment usually begins 6–12 months after getting a job.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a business loan?
A business loan provides working capital or funds for business expansion. It can be secured or unsecured depending on the lender.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a crop loan?
A crop loan (Kisan Credit Card) is a short-term loan for farmers to buy seeds, fertilizers, and equipment for their agricultural activities.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is collateral?
Collateral is an asset you offer the bank as security for a loan — like your house, car, or gold. If you don't repay, the bank can take it.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an EMI?
EMI stands for Equated Monthly Instalment. It's the fixed amount you pay every month to repay your loan, combining principal and interest.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a credit score?
A credit score is a number between 300 and 900 that shows how reliable you are as a borrower. A score above 750 is considered good.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is CIBIL score?
CIBIL score is a credit score by TransUnion CIBIL, the most commonly used credit bureau in India. Lenders check it before approving loans.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How can I improve my credit score?
Pay your EMIs and credit card bills on time, avoid applying for too many loans at once, and keep your credit utilisation below 30%.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a default on a loan?
Defaulting means failing to repay a loan as agreed. It damages your credit score and the bank can take legal action or seize your collateral.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a repo rate?
Repo rate is the rate at which RBI lends money to banks. When RBI raises it, banks also raise their lending rates, making loans costlier.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is reverse repo rate?
Reverse repo rate is the rate at which RBI borrows money from banks. It's used to control excess liquidity in the banking system.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the base rate?
The base rate is the minimum rate banks can lend at. It was replaced by MCLR in 2016 to make loan interest rates more transparent.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is MCLR?
MCLR is Marginal Cost of Funds based Lending Rate — the minimum interest rate below which a bank cannot lend. It adjusts monthly.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is simple interest?
Simple interest is calculated only on the original amount. For example, 10% simple interest on ₹10,000 gives ₹1,000 per year.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is compound interest?
Compound interest is calculated on the original amount plus previously earned interest. Your money grows faster with compounding.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a loan tenure?
Loan tenure is the total time you have to repay the loan. Longer tenures mean smaller EMIs but more total interest paid.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a loan sanction letter?
A loan sanction letter is an official document from the bank confirming your loan is approved, with details of the amount, interest rate, and repayment terms.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a loan disbursement?
Loan disbursement is when the bank actually transfers the approved loan money to your account or directly to the seller (in case of home or car loans).
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a loan statement?
A loan statement shows your outstanding principal, interest paid, EMIs paid so far, and the remaining schedule of payments.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is loan foreclosure?
Foreclosure means paying off your entire remaining loan balance before the tenure ends. Most banks allow this with minimal or no penalty for floating rate loans.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a prepayment penalty?
Some banks charge a fee if you repay your loan early. RBI has banned foreclosure charges on floating rate home and personal loans for individual borrowers.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a secured loan?
A secured loan requires collateral. If you don't repay, the lender takes your pledged asset. Examples: home loan, car loan, gold loan.
metadata: {"category": "Loans & Interest", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an unsecured loan?
An unsecured loan doesn't need collateral. It's based on your credit score and income. Examples: personal loan, credit card loan.
