metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is fiscal policy?
Fiscal policy is how the government uses taxes and public spending to influence the economy — like cutting taxes to boost growth or increasing spending.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is monetary policy?
Monetary policy is how the central bank controls money supply and interest rates to manage inflation and support economic growth.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a budget deficit?
A budget deficit happens when the government spends more than it earns through taxes and other revenues. It has to borrow to fill the gap.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a mutual fund?
A mutual fund pools money from many investors and invests it in stocks, bonds, or other securities managed by a professional fund manager.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a stock market?
A stock market is a marketplace where investors buy and sell shares of publicly listed companies. In India, the main exchanges are NSE and BSE.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a bond?
A bond is a debt investment where you lend money to a company or government. In return, you receive regular interest and your principal back at maturity.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is diversification?
Diversification means spreading your investments across different assets — stocks, bonds, gold, real estate — to reduce the impact of any single loss.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is foreign exchange?
Foreign exchange (forex) is the system for converting one country's currency into another. Exchange rates change constantly based on demand and supply.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the stock exchange?
A stock exchange is an organized platform where shares and securities are bought and sold. NSE and BSE are India's two main stock exchanges.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a share?
A share represents a small ownership stake in a company. When you buy shares, you become a part-owner and can profit from the company's growth.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a dividend?
A dividend is a portion of a company's profits paid out to its shareholders. It rewards investors for holding the company's stock.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a bull market?
A bull market is when stock prices are rising and investor confidence is high. It usually comes during strong economic growth.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a bear market?
A bear market is when stock prices fall 20% or more from recent highs. It usually happens during economic downturns or recessions.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a portfolio?
A portfolio is your complete collection of investments — stocks, bonds, mutual funds, FDs, real estate — held to meet your financial goals.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is risk and return?
Risk and return are linked. Higher return investments (like stocks) come with higher risk. Lower risk assets (like FDs) offer lower but stable returns.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a financial year?
In India, the financial year runs from April 1 to March 31. Taxes, bank interest, and company results are calculated for this period.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is income tax?
Income tax is a direct tax paid to the government based on your annual income. The rate depends on your income slab under the new or old tax regime.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is GST?
GST is Goods and Services Tax — a single indirect tax that replaced many older taxes. It is charged on the sale of goods and services across India.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is TDS?
TDS is Tax Deducted at Source. The payer deducts tax before making a payment — for interest, salary, rent — and deposits it with the government.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a direct tax?
A direct tax is paid directly by the person or entity on whom it is levied. Examples include income tax and corporate tax.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an indirect tax?
An indirect tax is collected by an intermediary (like a seller) from the consumer and paid to the government. GST is the main indirect tax in India.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is capital gains tax?
Capital gains tax is charged on profit made from selling an asset like shares or property. Short-term and long-term gains are taxed at different rates.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a demat account?
A demat account stores your shares and securities electronically, the way a bank account stores money. It's mandatory for trading in the stock market.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a trading account?
A trading account is used to place buy and sell orders in the stock market. It works alongside a demat account.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is NSE and BSE?
NSE (National Stock Exchange) and BSE (Bombay Stock Exchange) are India's two main stock exchanges where shares are bought and sold.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is SEBI?
SEBI is Securities and Exchange Board of India. It regulates the stock market, protects investors, and ensures fair trading practices.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is Sensex?
Sensex is BSE's benchmark index tracking 30 large and actively traded Indian companies. A rising Sensex generally indicates a growing economy.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is Nifty 50?
Nifty 50 is NSE's benchmark index tracking 50 large-cap Indian companies across sectors. It's widely used to gauge the health of the Indian stock market.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a systematic investment plan (SIP)?
SIP lets you invest a fixed amount in a mutual fund every month. It averages out market fluctuations and builds wealth over time through compounding.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is NAV of a mutual fund?
NAV is Net Asset Value — the price per unit of a mutual fund. It's calculated daily based on the current market value of the fund's investments.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is ELSS?
ELSS is Equity Linked Savings Scheme — a tax-saving mutual fund with a 3-year lock-in. Investments up to ₹1.5 lakh qualify for Section 80C deduction.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a debt fund?
A debt fund invests in bonds, government securities, and money market instruments. It's less risky than equity funds and offers more stable returns.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an equity fund?
An equity fund invests mainly in stocks. It offers higher potential returns but comes with more volatility and risk.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a hybrid fund?
A hybrid fund invests in both equity and debt. It balances growth and stability, making it suitable for moderate risk-takers.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is gold as an investment?
Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset in India. You can invest in physical gold, gold ETFs, or Sovereign Gold Bonds, which also pay annual interest.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is real estate investment?
Real estate investing means buying property — residential, commercial, or land — with the expectation of rental income or capital appreciation.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a Sovereign Gold Bond?
Sovereign Gold Bonds are government-issued bonds where the value is tied to gold prices. You also earn 2.5% annual interest and capital gains are tax-free at maturity.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an IPO?
An IPO (Initial Public Offering) is when a company sells shares to the public for the first time to raise capital. You can apply through your bank account via ASBA.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is ASBA?
ASBA (Application Supported by Blocked Amount) blocks the IPO application amount in your bank account and only deducts it if shares are allotted to you.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is net worth?
Net worth is the total value of everything you own (assets) minus everything you owe (liabilities). It's a measure of your overall financial health.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is financial planning?
Financial planning is the process of setting financial goals and creating a roadmap — through saving, investing, insuring, and budgeting — to achieve them.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is insurance?
Insurance is a contract where you pay a premium and the insurer pays a large sum to cover financial losses from events like illness, accident, or death.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is term insurance?
Term insurance is pure life insurance that pays a lump sum to your family if you die during the policy term. It has no maturity benefit and offers maximum cover at low cost.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a health insurance plan?
Health insurance covers medical expenses for hospitalization, surgery, and illness. It protects you from huge medical bills that can drain your savings.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is asset allocation?
Asset allocation is dividing your investment money among different asset types (equity, debt, gold, real estate) based on your risk appetite and financial goals.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is compounding?
Compounding is earning returns on both your original investment and the returns already earned. Over time, it dramatically increases wealth — which is why starting early matters.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is inflation's impact on savings?
Inflation erodes the purchasing power of your savings. If inflation is 6% and your FD earns 6%, your real return is zero. You need returns that beat inflation.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is liquidity risk?
Liquidity risk is when you can't access your money quickly enough — like having all savings in a long-term FD when an emergency hits.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an emergency fund?
An emergency fund is 3–6 months of expenses kept in a liquid savings account or liquid mutual fund to handle job loss, medical bills, or urgent repairs.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a budget?
A budget is a plan showing how you'll earn and spend money over a period. The 50-30-20 rule suggests spending 50% on needs, 30% on wants, and saving 20%.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is net banking security?
Net banking uses 256-bit encryption, OTP verification, session timeouts, and fraud monitoring to keep your online banking secure.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is foreign direct investment?
FDI is when a company or individual from one country invests directly in a business in another country by setting up operations or buying a major stake.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is foreign portfolio investment?
FPI is investment in a country's financial markets (stocks, bonds) by foreign investors, without direct control over the companies.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is forex reserves?
Forex reserves are foreign currency assets held by RBI (mainly US dollars, gold, and SDRs). They protect the rupee and cover import payments.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is balance of payments?
Balance of payments is a record of all financial transactions between India and the rest of the world — trade, services, investments, and transfers.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a current account deficit?
A current account deficit means India imports more goods and services than it exports, paying more to the world than it earns.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is purchasing power parity?
PPP is a theory that exchange rates should adjust so identical goods cost the same in every country when priced in a common currency.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a wealth manager?
A wealth manager provides personalized investment, tax, estate planning, and financial advice to high-net-worth individuals.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is estate planning?
Estate planning involves deciding how your assets will be distributed after your death — through a will, trusts, nominations, and insurance.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a will?
A will is a legal document stating how you want your assets distributed after death. Without a will, property is divided according to succession law.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the cost of living?
Cost of living is the amount of money needed to cover basic expenses — food, housing, transport, healthcare — in a particular city or region.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a credit rating agency?
Credit rating agencies like CRISIL, ICRA, and CARE evaluate the creditworthiness of companies and governments issuing bonds, rating them from AAA (best) to D (default).
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a AAA rated bond?
A AAA rated bond is considered the safest investment with the lowest risk of default. These are usually issued by the government or top-rated companies.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an index fund?
An index fund tracks a market index like Nifty 50 or Sensex, investing in the same stocks in the same proportion. Low cost and good for long-term investors.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an ETF?
An ETF (Exchange Traded Fund) is like a mutual fund but traded on the stock exchange like a share. It tracks an index, commodity, or sector.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is rupee depreciation?
Rupee depreciation means the rupee's value falls against foreign currencies like the US dollar. It makes imports costlier and can increase inflation.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is rupee appreciation?
Rupee appreciation means the rupee's value rises against other currencies. It makes imports cheaper and foreign travel more affordable.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an economic recession?
A recession is when the economy contracts — GDP falls for two consecutive quarters. Unemployment rises, businesses slow down, and consumer spending drops.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is economic growth?
Economic growth is measured by the percentage rise in GDP. A growing economy means more jobs, higher incomes, and better living standards.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is stagflation?
Stagflation is a rare economic situation with high inflation, slow growth, and high unemployment happening at the same time — very difficult to manage.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a credit default swap?
A CDS is a financial contract where the buyer pays a fee to the seller, who promises to compensate if a borrower defaults on a loan or bond.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is Basel III in banking?
Basel III introduced stricter capital requirements, leverage ratios, and liquidity standards for banks worldwide after the 2008 global financial crisis.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the money multiplier?
The money multiplier shows how much money banks can create from a base amount through lending. If CRR is 4%, the multiplier is 25x.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a financial bubble?
A financial bubble is when asset prices rise far above their real value due to speculation. When confidence collapses, prices crash rapidly — like the dot-com or housing bubble.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the repo rate effect on loans?
When RBI raises the repo rate, banks borrow at higher cost, so they raise lending rates. This makes home loans and personal loans costlier for customers.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is repo rate effect on FDs?
When RBI raises the repo rate, banks also tend to raise FD rates to attract deposits and fund their costlier lending, giving savers better returns.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a foreign exchange rate?
A foreign exchange rate is the price at which one currency can be exchanged for another — like ₹84 per US dollar. It changes constantly with market forces.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is core inflation?
Core inflation excludes food and fuel prices (which are volatile) to give a clearer picture of the underlying, persistent inflation trend in the economy.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the fiscal deficit?
Fiscal deficit is the difference between what the government spends and what it earns (excluding borrowed money). It must borrow to finance this gap.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is public debt?
Public debt is the total amount the government has borrowed over the years from domestic and foreign sources, to be repaid with interest in the future.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is crowd-funding?
Crowdfunding raises small amounts of money from a large number of people, usually via online platforms, to fund a startup, project, or social cause.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a fintech company?
A fintech (financial technology) company uses technology to provide financial services — like digital lending, insurance, investing, or payments — faster and cheaper than traditional banks.

chunk_text:
What is the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana?

chunk_text:
What is the National Pension System?
NPS is a voluntary, long-term retirement savings scheme regulated by PFRDA. You contribute during your working life and receive a pension after retirement. Contributions are tax-deductible.

chunk_text:
What is the Employee Provident Fund?
EPF is a retirement savings scheme where both employee and employer contribute 12% of basic salary each month. The corpus earns 8.15% annual interest and is tax-free at maturity.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a dividend yield?
Dividend yield is the annual dividend paid by a company as a percentage of its share price. A higher yield means better income for investors relative to price.

chunk_text:
What is a P/E ratio?
Price-to-Earnings ratio is the share price divided by earnings per share. A high P/E may mean the stock is expensive; a low P/E may signal undervaluation.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a rights issue?
A rights issue is when a company offers existing shareholders the right to buy additional shares at a discounted price to raise more capital.
metadata: {"category": "General Finance", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:

chunk_text:
What is a stock split?
A stock split divides existing shares into more shares of lower face value. It makes the stock more affordable for small investors without changing total market value.

What is the minimum age to get a credit card?
You must be at least 18 years old to get a primary credit card. Some banks require a minimum age of 21.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I increase my credit card limit?
Request a limit increase through net banking, mobile app, or by calling the helpline. The bank reviews your income and repayment history before approving.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I avoid credit card interest charges?
Pay the full outstanding bill amount by the due date every month. Paying only the minimum amount will attract interest on the remaining balance.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the process for a credit card dispute?
Log in to net banking, raise a transaction dispute, or call the helpline. The bank investigates and initiates a chargeback to the merchant if the dispute is valid.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I cancel a standing instruction?
Log in to net banking and go to 'Manage Mandates' or call the helpline to cancel the standing instruction before the next debit date.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I check my loan outstanding balance?
Log in to mobile banking or net banking and go to the loans section. You'll see outstanding principal, upcoming EMI, and the full repayment schedule.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": true}

chunk_text:
What is the process to get a home loan top-up?
Apply to your bank with latest salary slips, property documents, and existing loan statements. Approval depends on your repayment history and current LTV ratio.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I get CIBIL report with details?
Visit cibil.com, register, and pay a fee for a full report. Your bank may also provide it through their app. It shows all loans, repayment history, and hard enquiries.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I add a joint holder to my bank account?
Visit the branch with the new joint holder and their KYC documents. Fill a joint account addition form and specify the mode of operation.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I change nominee in a bank account?
Fill a nomination change form at the branch or through the online banking portal, providing the new nominee's name, relationship, and date of birth.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What documents are needed for KYC update?
Aadhaar card, PAN card, and proof of current address (utility bill, rental agreement). For businesses, a company registration certificate is also needed.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I request for duplicate PAN card?
Apply on the NSDL or UTIITSL website with your Aadhaar details and a small fee. The duplicate card is delivered by post within 15 business days.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I link PAN to my bank account?
Visit your branch or use net banking. Submit a PAN linking request. PAN linking with bank accounts is needed for TDS computation and financial reporting.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the process for PMJJBY insurance renewal?
Your PMJJBY premium (₹436/year) is auto-debited from your savings account on the renewal date. Ensure sufficient balance before May 31 each year.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the process to get credit card physical form delivered?
After credit card approval, the card is sent to your registered mailing address within 5–7 business days. Track dispatch status through the bank's app.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I convert a debit card purchase to EMI?
Call the bank helpline within the specified days of purchase or use the mobile app. Select the transaction, choose EMI tenure, and confirm. A small processing fee applies.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I set up auto pay for credit card?
Register for NACH mandate with your bank, linking your savings account to auto-debit the minimum due or full outstanding amount on the credit card due date.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I get a loan repayment certificate for IT purposes?
Request a provisional or final interest certificate from the bank's branch or net banking portal. It shows total interest paid in the financial year for tax filing.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the process for an e-mandate cancellation?
Log in to net banking, go to 'Mandates / AutoPay', select the active mandate, and click cancel. Some mandates may also be cancelled through the company's portal.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I set up alerts for low balance?
Log in to net banking or the mobile app, go to alert settings, and enable low balance alerts. Enter the threshold amount below which you want to be notified.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I update my email ID in the bank?
Visit the branch or use net banking account settings to update your email. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile for verification.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I get a no-dues certificate from the bank?
Once you repay a loan fully, request a no-dues or loan closure certificate from the bank. It's usually issued within 3–5 working days after all dues are cleared.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I check if my FD is auto-renewed?
Log in to mobile or net banking and check the FD details page. The renewal date and status will show if it has been auto-renewed and at what rate.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I get a copy of my sanction letter for a loan?
Log in to net banking or visit the branch to request a copy of your loan sanction letter. It's useful for tax filing and verifying loan terms.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I avoid SIM swap fraud?
Never share your mobile number or Aadhaar with strangers. If your SIM stops working suddenly, immediately call your telecom provider and bank to block access.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
How do I opt out of telemarketing calls from my bank?
Register your number on the DND (Do Not Disturb) registry by calling 1909 or through TRAI's website. You can also ask your bank to remove you from marketing lists.
metadata: {"category": "Customer Service", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is life insurance?
Life insurance pays a lump sum to your family if you pass away during the policy term. It financially protects your dependents.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is term insurance?
Term insurance is the purest form of life insurance. It covers death risk at a low premium with no maturity benefit if you survive.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is endowment insurance?
Endowment insurance combines life cover with savings. It pays out on death or on maturity of the policy, whichever comes first.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is whole life insurance?
Whole life insurance covers you for your entire life (or up to age 99–100). It builds cash value over time that you can borrow against.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is ULIP?
Unit Linked Insurance Plan (ULIP) combines insurance with market-linked investment. Part of your premium goes into funds (equity, debt, hybrid).
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a health insurance deductible?
A deductible is the amount you must pay out of pocket before your health insurance starts covering the medical bill.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a cashless hospitalization?
With cashless hospitalization, your insurer directly settles the bill with the hospital (from a network list), so you don't need to pay and claim later.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a health insurance co-payment?
Co-payment is a fixed percentage of the medical bill you pay yourself, while the insurer pays the rest. For example, 10% co-pay on a ₹1 lakh bill means you pay ₹10,000.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a waiting period in health insurance?
A waiting period is a time after purchasing the policy during which certain conditions (pre-existing diseases, maternity) are not covered.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a pre-existing disease clause?
Pre-existing diseases (conditions you had before buying the policy) are usually not covered for 2–4 years after purchasing health insurance.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a sum insured in insurance?
Sum insured is the maximum amount your insurer will pay in a year for your health or the lump sum paid in life insurance on death/maturity.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a premium in insurance?
A premium is the regular amount you pay (monthly, quarterly, or annually) to keep your insurance policy active.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a claim in insurance?
A claim is when you formally ask the insurance company to pay you for a loss covered under your policy — like a medical bill or life insurance payout.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a maturity benefit in insurance?
Maturity benefit is the amount paid to you at the end of the insurance policy term if you're still alive. Applicable in endowment and ULIP plans.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a death benefit in insurance?
Death benefit is the amount paid to your nominee when you die during the active policy period.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an annuity plan?
An annuity plan is an insurance product that provides a regular income — monthly, quarterly, or annually — typically used for retirement planning.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the PMJJBY scheme?
Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana gives ₹2 lakh life cover for an annual premium of ₹436. Your bank auto-debits the premium from your account.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the PMSBY scheme?
Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana offers ₹2 lakh accidental death and disability cover for just ₹20 per year, auto-debited from your savings account.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is Ayushman Bharat Yojana?
Ayushman Bharat provides health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year to economically vulnerable households for secondary and tertiary hospitalization, completely free.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is ESIC?
ESIC (Employees' State Insurance Corporation) provides health, maternity, and accident insurance to employees earning up to ₹21,000/month. Premium is shared by employer and employee.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is EPF?
Employee Provident Fund is a retirement savings scheme where both employee and employer contribute 12% of basic salary. Interest is 8.15% p.a., tax-free on maturity.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is EPS?
Employee Pension Scheme is part of the EPF. 8.33% of the employer's share goes into EPS, providing a monthly pension after retirement.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is NPS?
National Pension System is a voluntary retirement savings scheme regulated by PFRDA. Contributions earn market-linked returns, and part of the corpus buys an annuity at retirement.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the APY scheme?
Atal Pension Yojana guarantees a monthly pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 after age 60 for workers in the unorganized sector, with contributions starting from as low as ₹42/month.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana?
SSY is a savings scheme for the girl child offering ~8.2% interest. It matures when the girl turns 21 and contributions qualify for 80C deduction.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the Senior Citizen Savings Scheme?
SCSS offers a 5-year savings option for those above 60 with the highest interest rate among post office/bank schemes (currently 8.2%). Qualifies for 80C deduction.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the post office savings scheme?
Post offices offer savings products like savings accounts, RD, TD (fixed deposit), MIS, NSC, KVP, SCSS, PPF, and Sukanya Samriddhi under Government Small Savings Schemes.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the National Savings Certificate?
NSC is a 5-year government savings bond issued by post offices offering ~7.7% annual interest. It qualifies for Section 80C deduction and interest is reinvested.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is Kisan Vikas Patra?
KVP is a post office savings certificate where your money doubles in a fixed period (currently ~115 months). No income tax benefit but a safe government-backed option.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the Post Office Monthly Income Scheme?
POMIS is a 5-year scheme where you deposit a lump sum and receive fixed monthly interest. Safe for retirees needing regular income — currently offering 7.4% p.a.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana?
RVY is a government scheme providing senior citizens from the BPL category with free assistive devices like hearing aids, wheelchairs, and spectacles.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is PM Vaya Vandana Yojana?
PMVVY is a pension scheme from LIC of India for senior citizens above 60, offering assured returns of 7.4% p.a. for 10 years, paid as monthly, quarterly, or annual pension.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the Stand-Up India scheme?
Stand-Up India provides loans from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore to SC/ST and women entrepreneurs to set up greenfield enterprises, with bank branches covering at least one such borrower each.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is PM SVANidhi?
PM SVANidhi is a micro-credit scheme for street vendors offering ₹10,000 initial loans, growing to ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 on timely repayment, with a 7% interest subsidy.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro & Small Enterprises?
CGTMSE provides collateral-free credit guarantee coverage to banks lending to MSMEs, encouraging banks to lend without security to small businesses.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the MUDRA Bank?
MUDRA (Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency) refinances banks and MFIs to provide loans to micro-enterprises. It doesn't lend directly but sets policy for MUDRA loans.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the Jan Suraksha Scheme?
Jan Suraksha comprises PMJJBY (life cover), PMSBY (accident cover), and APY (pension), providing low-cost social security to millions of unorganized sector workers.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana?
PMAY provides interest subsidies on home loans to make housing affordable. EWS (income below ₹3L) gets 6.5% subsidy; LIG (₹3–6L) 6.5%; MIG I/II get lower subsidies.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is DICGC insurance?
DICGC insures bank deposits up to ₹5 lakh per depositor per bank. If the bank fails, you are guaranteed to get back up to ₹5 lakh from DICGC.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a general insurance policy?
General insurance covers non-life assets and health — like car insurance, home insurance, health insurance, and travel insurance. It typically renews every year.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a third-party motor insurance?
Third-party insurance is mandatory for all vehicles in India. It covers damage or injury caused to another person or vehicle in an accident involving your vehicle.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is comprehensive vehicle insurance?
Comprehensive insurance covers damage to your own vehicle in addition to third-party liability — from accidents, theft, fire, flood, and natural disasters.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is IDV in vehicle insurance?
IDV is Insured Declared Value — the maximum amount the insurer will pay if your vehicle is stolen or totally damaged. It reduces each year as the vehicle ages.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a no-claim bonus in vehicle insurance?
If you don't make any claim in a year, you get a no-claim bonus — a discount of 20–50% on the premium for the next year.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is travel insurance?
Travel insurance covers you during a trip for medical emergencies, trip cancellation, lost luggage, flight delays, and passport loss.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is fire insurance?
Fire insurance covers damage to property and assets from fire, lightning, explosion, and related perils. Required for commercial properties and often recommended for homes.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is marine insurance?
Marine insurance covers goods in transit — by sea, air, or land. It protects merchants and exporters from losses due to cargo damage or delay.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is crop insurance?
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) provides insurance coverage to farmers against crop losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases at low premiums.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a microinsurance plan?
Microinsurance provides small, low-cost coverage to low-income individuals for health, life, or assets. It's designed to be simple and affordable for rural and informal workers.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the IRDAI?
IRDAI is the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India. It licenses and regulates all insurance companies and protects policyholders in India.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a policy surrender value?
Surrender value is the amount you receive if you cancel your life insurance policy before maturity. It's less than the premiums paid, especially if surrendered early.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a paid-up policy?
A paid-up policy is one where you stop paying premiums but retain a reduced sum assured. The policy continues with a lower benefit.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a lapsed insurance policy?
A policy lapses when you miss premium payments beyond the grace period. Coverage stops. You may revive it within 2–5 years by paying arrears with interest.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is policy revival?
A lapsed policy can be revived by paying all overdue premiums plus interest and sometimes passing a medical examination, within the revival period of 2–5 years.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a free-look period in insurance?
Free-look period is a 15–30 day window after receiving your policy document. If you're unhappy, you can return it and get a full premium refund.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a rider in insurance?
A rider is an add-on benefit attached to your base insurance policy — like critical illness rider, accidental disability rider, or waiver of premium rider.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is critical illness insurance?
Critical illness insurance pays a lump sum on diagnosis of specified illnesses like cancer, heart attack, stroke, or kidney failure, regardless of actual medical expenses.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a hospital daily cash policy?
A hospital daily cash plan pays a fixed daily allowance (₹500–₹2,000) for each day you're hospitalized, to cover incidental costs not covered by regular health insurance.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is group insurance?
Group insurance is a single policy covering a group of people — like company employees or bank account holders under PMJJBY. It's cheaper than individual policies.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is an insurance agent?
An insurance agent is licensed by IRDAI to sell insurance products on behalf of one insurer. A broker can sell products of multiple insurers and offers comparison services.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the claims settlement ratio of an insurer?
Claims settlement ratio is the percentage of total claims settled by an insurer in a year. A higher ratio (above 95%) indicates a reliable insurer.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the National Health Mission?
NHM is a government program providing affordable healthcare services, especially maternal and child health, to underserved populations in urban and rural India.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is the Central Government Health Scheme?
CGHS provides comprehensive health facilities to Central Government employees, pensioners, and their families through dispensaries and empanelled hospitals.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": false, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a gratuity?
Gratuity is a one-time payment given by an employer to an employee on retirement or resignation after 5 or more years of service. Calculated as 15 days' salary per year of service.
metadata: {"category": "Insurance & Govt Schemes", "source_name": "banking_knowledge_base_1000.xlsx", "verification_status": "DEMO_LABELLED", "answer_label": "Demo knowledge - not confirmed HDFC Bank policy", "needs_fact_check": true, "product_ambiguous": false}

chunk_text:
What is a provident fund?
